label: Dubstep / Moombahcore (Moombahton Tempo, Dubstep Drums)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 105-112 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: Energetic and rowdy: a short intro with drums and a sweep builds fast, a snare-roll build drops into a bouncing wobble-bass groove, a breakdown strips to percussion and a siren, and a harder second drop adds FM stabs before an abrupt…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Short, clipped vocal one-shots, such as hype shouts and single words, are cut into the build-ups as rhythmic punctuation.
cards.palette: A thick wobble bass with tempo-synced modulation and a distorted layer plays a bouncing off-beat riff over a clean sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 108 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)

cards.mood: Fast and playful: a rave-style synth line opens over a bouncing pulse, a drum-fill build leads to a first drop of syncopated bass stabs, a break of toms and chopped vocals follows, and the second drop combines the stabs with a rolling…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Chopped, pitched vocal hits are played like a synth, forming short melodic stabs between the bass phrases.
cards.palette: Distorted, FM-style bass stabs alternate with a rolling wobble on a syncopated pattern, over a mono sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 112 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)

cards.mood: Heavy and rowdy: a spoken-style call opens over a bare bouncing pulse, chants answer between the bass phrases in the drops, a short stripped break leaves toms and claps, and a final drop piles on a second bass voice.
cards.vocal: A small group of voices chants in unison with a gruff, shouted timbre; there is no lead singer.
cards.palette: A wobbling mid-bass riff built on square-wave modulation sits over a sub and is answered by the chant calls.
cards.tempo_line: written 105 BPM, felt as written (no half-time)
